15th Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Spiraling Chains

You never know when to give up. You’re not even sure if you know what that means. Every challenge is something you rise to. Believe it.

When you roll a natural 20, on any d20 based roll, while in combat you regain 1 Spiral Cell. Additionally, when you would fail a d20 based roll, you can spend 2 Spiral Cells to remake the failed roll, gaining a rank of Mastery to the new result.
